title: Local Persistence & Storage Hierarchy (Swallowed I/O Exceptions, Unlocked Snapshot Writes, Fly Volume Scope)

findings.issue: Silent I/O exception swallowing: internal/store/soul_map_io.py:128-129 catches Exception and passes on os.replace failure, returning mutated in-memory blob. Failed disk persistence appears as success until restart.
Unlocked snapshot writes: score_snapshots.py:110-116 performs os.replace without path locks, outside soul_map_io.
Fly volume process binding: fly.toml lines 129-132 mounts data_volume -> /app/data for processes = ['web'] only.
SQLite volume backing: chain_client.py:36-41 connects to data/volume_cache.db with default sqlite3 connection settings.
